da-vacuous.evidence: topological-mass-conjecture.lean:178-186 instance trivialVortex sets holonomy=0, N=0, mass=0, decomp := by simp
da-vacuous.notes: The downstream theorems (mass_unique, mass_nonneg, mass_eq_holonomy_of_flat, mass_gt_holonomy_of_dilog_pos, mass_mono_of_extra_dilog) are genuine and proved from decomp. But the only supplied instance is the trivial N=0/mass=0 vortex, which encodes none of the conjectural content (the docstring admits this). The conjecture class itself is content-bearing (carries the decomp field), so this is a warn, not a fail: the §3b-cond hypothesis is discharged only by a degenerate instance.

da-circular.notes: No back-fitting: the decomposition is an open conjecture with three explicit proof obligations (.md lines 39-53), not a derivation that assumes its target.

da-overclaim.evidence: .ts:4 label 'prop:topological-decomposition-mass' + builder proposition(); title 'Conjectural Topological Decomposition of Mass'; .md:29 'The present conjecture'; .lean:7 'conjectural' and axiomatized as a class
da-overclaim.notes: Block kind is 'proposition' and label prefix 'prop:' but the content is explicitly a conjecture (title, .md prose, Lean class-axiomatization all say conjectural). Per AGENTS.md §3b, a statement carrying an unproved conjectural claim should be kind 'conjecture' (conj: prefix). Labelling it a proposition overclaims its epistemic status. The Lean correctly axiomatizes it as a class, but the .ts manifest's provable kind is inconsistent.

da-lean-narrative-divergence.evidence: .lean:68-82 class TopologicalDecompositionMass with decomp field; downstream theorems lines 94-168 proved unconditionally from decomp
da-lean-narrative-divergence.notes: The Lean does NOT prove the conjecture (correctly — it axiomatizes it as a class hypothesis). The downstream theorems prove only generic consequences of an abstract 'mass = holonomy + Σ dilog' equation over an OrderedAddCommMonoid; they do not touch the substantive content (holonomy = descent trace, dilog = Φ_q evaluation, finite blow-up locus). This is acceptable §3b-cond conditional-class practice, but the Lean's structural results are far weaker than the .md's three proof obligations suggest, and the sole instance is trivial — warn for the gap between Lean coverage and narrative claim.

da-referee-verdict.notes: VERDICT: minor-revision. referee_argument: The block is honest as a conjecture in its prose and Lean (correctly class-axiomatized with proved downstream consequences). The principal objection is the kind/label mismatch — it is filed as a 'proposition' (prop:) while every textual and Lean signal says 'conjecture'; per AGENTS.md §3b an unproved claim of this kind must be kind 'conjecture'. Secondary: the only Lean instance (trivialVortex) is degenerate (mass=0), so no non-trivial witness of the decomposition exists, and a garbled clause at .md:47 obscures the finiteness criterion. Re-kind to conjecture and supply (or honestly defer) a non-trivial instance.
